evals.prompt: Extract all figures from Draft/CBAM_20260501.docx and put them in a separate subfolder. This will be incorporated into latex file later.
evals.expected_output: A figures/ subfolder with 4 panel images (Figure 1, 2x2 layout), converted from EMF to 300 DPI PNG, named by content (e.g., fig1_eu_new_supplier.png), plus a README.md with mapping table, captions, and a ready-to-paste LaTeX subcaption snippet. EMF originals preserved alongside.

assertions.name: png_count
assertions.description: At least 4 PNG files exist in the output folder

assertions.name: emf_preserved
assertions.description: Original EMF/WMF files are preserved alongside PNGs

assertions.name: readme_exists
assertions.description: README.md exists in the output folder

assertions.name: readme_has_latex
assertions.description: README contains LaTeX figure code (\begin{figure} or \includegraphics)

assertions.name: readme_has_caption
assertions.description: README contains figure caption text from the document

assertions.name: content_aware_naming
assertions.description: At least one PNG has a content-aware name (not img_\d+\.png pattern)
